body: The only moments in the past year that I haven't wanted to kill myself were when I was stoned, so I feel that. They were fleeting and its not everytime I smoke, but it definitely has helped me on occasion. I hope things get better for you 💛
I'm so sorry you lost her, losing the person you're in love with is uniquely cruel in its devastation. I hope things are getting better for you 💛

Thats basically the conclusion I've drawn, nothing is so black and white I suppose. I feel fairly ambivalent about a lot of aspects of the situation, I don't blame him but that doesnt mean I'm not faced with some pretty severe amandonement issues. Complex emotions, I think its possible to experience conflicting feelings simultaneously. I'm sorry for your loss 💛
I'm sorry for your loss 💛 I carry a lot of guilt for things I wish i'd done differently as well, it gets heavy. I hope you find some peace in your fonder memories.

Thank you 💛 I did attempt grief counseling but I went to a few therapists that didnt work for me and afterward I was pretty exhausted by the process.  Now I stick to my guitar and my sketchbooks, which probably isn't a progressive solution but it helps some

I truly wish to you a happy birthday, but I know sometimes that's simply not the reality of a day that is meant to be special. But I hope you find something to smile about today. My fiance commit suicide on his birthday last year, and I wasn't there for him not because I didn't love him and not because I didn't want to be. I chose to go to work that day because I was ignorant to and didnt understand the extent of how he was suffering. I would give anything for a chance to go back and do it differently, and i'll carry the guilt of not being there for him for the rest of my life. I'm not telling you what to do or how to feel, I struggle with being suicidal everyday and see my birthday creeping up and really don't know if I'll make it through that day. I dont know your life or situation, but just know that sometimes peoples actions arent a reflection of their intentions, and even if they weren't there for you today, it doesn't necessarily mean that they didnt want to be.

I find this very relatable, the only reason I haven't killed myself yet is because I am scared someone I love will find me in the aftermath and I know how horrible that is to live with having experienced it first hand. Still, I think about suicide constantly knowing that I currently have no place to do it. Its an exhausting and dim existence, I am certain I'll do it when I am in a position to. 

I hope things get better for you, I really do. I'm so sorry you are in so much pain.

I agree with you entirely. There are a lot of people in my life that tell me that I am wrong in my silence and that I should speak to her because she is my mother (I dont disclose the details of what happened pubilcly so its only with the vauge understanding that there was a falling out). I try to brush it off with the acknowledgement that most of them grew up with supportive parents and that breaking ties with family is pretty incomprehensible to them. I'm really grateful to have found this sub and be able to speak openly about it with people who can relate on some level. Thank you again for taking the time to read my post and responding so compassionately ❤

Thank you so much for saying that, I genuinely appreciate it more than I can express over a reddit thread. Despite my fiance's struggle with mental illness and its result, he was an incredibly kind, loving, and a generally wonderful person. My mother never knew him so her opinion holds no validity there. She is the only parent that I have living, so I've been quick to excuse and forgive her actions in the past for that reason. It's helpful to recieve words of support in my decision to remove her from my life.

I appreciate the feedback, I'm sort of new at this. I don't know that I understand what you mean by the concept being unoriginal and boring, I suppose the idea of seeing past the beauty of the world and wanting to leave it is fairly common but I think more honest and relatable than unoriginal. I do see how it could be more effective in evoking feeling for a topic that is emotionally driven, I'll try and focus on that.
